title: Please Read Honest Review
body: While the game was advertised as relatively simplistic with a few hooks that draw you in that obviously will get you to download the game, when you download it it’s obvious it’s not what was advertised. However, the game has its high and it has some lows. In the beginning. It does a good job of rewarding you with tons of rewards and quests things like that and then as you level up more, you start to get to a halt, and eventually the rewards that you were given has to end up being used as a resource to advance your progression. Now the biggest issue I have is the lack of activities to do once you get to a certain progression level specifically it introduces you to a campaign with some dialogue that feels very interesting with the story, but the actual campaign doesn’t last that long and the rewards towards the I’d say the latter half of the campaign it gets very stagnant and the rewards aren’t suffice enough for you to progress or upgrade your base or heroes nor are they rewarding enough for completing the entire campaign. After you finish the campaign there’s literally about 2-3 activities for you to do. I say this to say. Don’t expect much and treat this game as a meager time waster when you’re looking for time to kill. Game is infested with bots. I’ve gotten several bots private messaging me. Most alliances require you to have discord or telegram or you’ll get kicked hurting the maximization of you upgrading and getting rewards. I’m likely to believe they are bots too. The game is constantly throwing micro transactions in your face. Nearly 95% of potential good rewards are paywalled. They even use this tactic of throwing in a legendary character for 2.99 only to eventually give it to you. There’s more I could say but this is the game summed up. Nothing uniquely different from its predecessors. I give it a one star so it’s easier to find this review

And I gave the game well over an hour, hoping there would at least be some of that gameplay from the ad at some point in time. It is crystal clear there will never be, because when I was playing in the demo and how I was gathering resources was entirely different than how you gather those same exact resources in the game. And it makes no sense, because the demo was a lot of fun, but the game is itself is god-awfully boring. You build a town for yourself to heal the people in the village, and all you do is repeatedly tap on buttons to automate processes that the game walks you through. There is no strategy at all whatsoever and no challenge either, because there is no real gameplay. You literally just do everything that you are instructed to do from the game itself, repeatedly tapping on the squares it tells you to. Extremely boring.

title: Deleted My Account… Except It’s STILL THERE
body: Absolutely unbelievable. I asked support to DELETE an old account. They told me deletion would take 14 days. After 14 days, suddenly it was “another 3 days.” Then I was locked out of the account while the actual account remained visible in the game. Here’s where it gets ridiculous: support then told me the account had been deleted and the data cleared. Except the base was STILL THERE, people could STILL message it, and its Might was STILL CHANGING. How exactly does a “deleted” account keep changing??? I repeatedly asked for a manager/supervisor. Completely ignored. Instead I got generic copy/paste responses telling me the account was deleted, then that what I was seeing was a “temporary display issue,” then that they checked their logs and found “no abnormalities.” I HAVE SCREENSHOTS. So which is it? Deleted? A display error? A data anomaly? If the data was actually erased, explain how an account that supposedly no longer exists can remain visible and show changing stats. I spent real money on this account. If you are going to lock a player out, claim their data was deleted, yet leave the account functioning in the game, players deserve an explanation. And PLEASE don’t reply to this review with another canned “Dear Player” response. Have an actual human being in management review what happened and explain it.

title: Totally deceived by a playing-Ad
body: This is my first game review on the App Store, I don’t play many phone games these days. I was chilling and playing a mahjong game when an Ad popped up for this game. You played as a Plague Doctor with spinning blades around you, chopping down resources. You walked around and built things, with your items stacked behind you. Everything was done manually with your character. It seemed so interesting. The real game has a little of that, but it’s just to lure you in at the beginning. The vast majority of the game is a large, online strategy game which becomes increasingly more P2W because of all the time sinks required for upgrades. I was deeply hooked into it for a couple hours, exploring the gameplay and storyline, until I realized I was playing a totally different game than I signed up for. I kept hoping the game would end up as it was advertised, but eventually I realized I had just been sold on it. I deleted the game. Would rather spend my time finding a game I actually want to play, not just that I’m hooked on. 2* because the game seems cool on its own, just wasn’t what I was sold on. The story is interesting, but it’s so obvious the characters were created with AI. Hope this helps. Good luck gamers

title: Fine gameplay, awful mismatched graphics
body: Perfectly entertaining gameplay is tarnished by conflicting, unnecessary AI generated visuals. The AI portraits and occasional story graphic are so jarring in comparison to the atmosphere of the game that it’s almost laughable. You’ve got this like, dingy run down plague setting, and the characters fit well when they’re the low poly 3D models. But the second their AI portraits pops up it’s like… wow, that’s John Mobilegame and Jane AI. All the men have exaggerated cartoonish features, which would be fine if it was consistent at all and made with deliberate intention, but it’s not. And the women are genuinely baffling in this setting. Picture the typical AI generated woman, that’s literally it. Uncanny, way too clean for the setting, and NOTHING like the men. The worst part is none of these portraits are necessary. The low poly 3D models are a vibe and they would work just fine on the selection screens, and the talking portraits are unneeded because the text box and character models being on screen more than suffice. The gameplay is fun but so remarkably standard that the only reason you would choose this app over others is the aesthetic and story, but it’s ruined by the lazy addition of AI that completely takes you out of the setting. We need to have better standards, seriously. Put intention and effort into your game, throwing needless AI in there makes you seem like a money hungry tech bro.
